title: Coming out after retirement: Daily Mail and Ty Roberts interviews
place_text: UK Daily Mail; International UFO Bureau (Oklahoma City)

tellings.quote: >> on on the 4th of May, uh Josh Boswell came out with uh an interview uh from the UK Daily Mail.

plain: A former NASA doctor named Greg Rogers, who says he saw a UFO in a secret hangar, says he went public only after he retired, first in an interview by the reporter Josh Boswell in the UK Daily Mail that came out on 4 May 2025. Rogers tells this himself, and says he also gave an interview to a man named Ty Roberts of the International UFO Bureau in Oklahoma City, for a show called Total Disclosure. It is how he explains why a witness like him stayed quiet for so long.
